name: dobe_lean_strings
desc: keep the doberman pose, head, face, closed eyes, smirk, body, arm, hand, colors, size and position exactly the same. Add plenty of thick sticky pink goo strings stretched long from its chest, belly and the underside of its arm toward the right and down, as if it is being pulled away from a sticky goo pillar to its right, strings sagging and thinning in the middle, some droplets. Same pixel art rendering and line weight.
